mapper.sql: id, problem_id, user_id, language, code, status, time_used_ms, memory_used_kb, compile_message, judge_message, judge_key_id, judge_node_id, claim_token, claimed_at, lease_expires_at, attempt_count, created_at, judged_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submissions (problem_id, user_id, language, code, status, time_used_ms, memory_used_kb, compile_message, judge_message, created_at, judged_at) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{userId}, #{language}, #{code}, #{status}, #{timeUsedMs}, #{memoryUsedKb}, #{compileMessage}, #{judgeMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{judgedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM submissions WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.problem_id, p.title AS problem_title, s.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, s.language, s.status, s.time_used_ms, s.memory_used_kb, s.created_at FROM submissions s JOIN problems p ON p.id = s.problem_id JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submissions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND problem_id = #{problemId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
SELECT id FROM submissions WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id FROM submissions WHERE status = 'PENDING'
AND language IN
#{language}
ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE submissions SET status = 'JUDGING' WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE submissions SET status = 'JUDGING', judge_key_id = #{judgeKeyId}, judge_node_id = #{judgeNodeId}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE submissions SET status = #{status}, time_used_ms = #{timeUsedMs}, memory_used_kb = #{memoryUsedKb}, compile_message = #{compileMessage}, judge_message = #{judgeMessage}, judged_at = #{judgedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE submissions SET status = 'PENDING', judge_key_id = NULL, judge_node_id = NULL, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'JUDGING'

UPDATE submissions SET status = 'SYSTEM_ERROR', judge_message = #{message}, judged_at = #{judgedAt}, judge_key_id = NULL, judge_node_id = NULL, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'JUDGING'

UPDATE submissions SET status = 'PENDING', judge_key_id = NULL, judge_node_id = NULL, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE status = 'JUDGING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now} AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}

UPDATE submissions SET status = 'SYSTEM_ERROR', judge_message = #{message}, judged_at = #{now}, judge_key_id = NULL, judge_node_id = NULL, claim_token = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE status = 'JUDGING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now} AND attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts}
UPDATE submissions SET status = 'PENDING' WHERE status = 'JUDGING'
